# Archival Dispatch: 13 Master Broadcasts Dated Across Aladdin's Lamp, Bob Elson, Bill Stern, and Ellery Queen

**Date**: 2026-08-21  
**Author**: radio index  
**Tags**: Aladdin's Lamp, Bob Elson, 20th Century Limited, Victor Mature, Hugh Herbert, Bill Stern, Babe Ruth, Ellery Queen, Heartbeat Theatre, Bobby Hammack, Superstition, Original Filenames

---

## Batch 79 Forensic Discoveries

Batch 79 recovers and dates 13 historical broadcasts spanning 1930s musical romance, roving celebrity train and flight interviews, sports documentary tributes, micro-detective enigmas, Salvation Army dramas, and mid-century jazz: 4 sweet romantic serenades from ***Aladdin's Lamp*** (1935), 3 live passenger and celebrity interviews from roving broadcaster Bob Elson on ***Bob Elson on the 20th Century Limited*** (including movie stars Victor Mature and Hugh Herbert, plus airline flagships, 1946–1947), Bill Stern's poignant tribute to baseball legend Babe Ruth on ***Bill Stern's Sports Newsreel*** (broadcast August 20, 1948 following the Sultan of Swat's passing), 2 rapid deduction cases from ***Ellery Queen's Minute Mysteries*** (1947), 2 inspirational narratives from ***Heartbeat Theatre*** (1968–1969), the Bobby Hammack jazz quartet (1955), and folklore investigation on ***Superstition*** (1948).
